declarations.name: divergence
declarations.statement:
def divergence (ψ : E → ℝ) (x y : E) : ℝ :=
  ψ x - ψ y - fderiv ℝ ψ y (x - y)

declarations.name: divergence_self
declarations.statement:
theorem divergence_self (ψ : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    divergence ψ x x = 0

declarations.name: three_point_identity
declarations.statement:
theorem three_point_identity (ψ : E → ℝ) (x y z : E) :
    divergence ψ z x + divergence ψ x y - divergence ψ z y =
      (fderiv ℝ ψ y - fderiv ℝ ψ x) (z - x)

declarations.name: divergence_nonneg
declarations.statement:
theorem divergence_nonneg (X : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (hψ : ConvexOn ℝ X ψ)
    (x y : E) (hx : x ∈ X) (hy : y ∈ X) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ y) :
    0 ≤ divergence ψ x y

declarations.name: proximal_one_step
declarations.statement:
theorem proximal_one_step (V : Set E) (f ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (x p : E) (hp : p ∈ V) (hf : ConvexOn ℝ V f)
    (hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x) (hdp : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ p)
    (hmin : IsMinOn (fun z => f z + η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x) V p) :
    ∀ u ∈ V, η * (f p - f u) ≤
      divergence ψ u x - divergence ψ u p - divergence ψ p x

declarations.name: divergence_eq_gradient
declarations.context: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
declarations.statement:
theorem divergence_eq_gradient (ψ : E → ℝ) (x y : E)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ y) :
    divergence ψ x y = ψ x - ψ y - inner ℝ (gradient ψ y) (x - y)

declarations.name: nonquadratic_nonsmooth
declarations.statement:
theorem nonquadratic_nonsmooth :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ univ (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      IsMinOn (fun z : ℝ => |z| + divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2) z (1 / 2)) univ 0 ∧
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (abs : ℝ → ℝ) 0 ∧
      divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2) (1 / 2) 0 = 9 / 64 ∧
      divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2) 0 (1 / 2) = 11 / 64 ∧
      (∀ u : ℝ, -|u| ≤ divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2) u (1 / 2) -
        divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2) u 0 - divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2) 0 (1 / 2)) ∧
      (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ -5 / 16

declarations.name: boundary_outside_initial
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_outside_initial :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ univ (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      (-1 : ℝ) ∉ Icc 0 1 ∧
      IsMinOn (fun z : ℝ => |z| + divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2 / 2) z (-1)) (Icc 0 1) 0 ∧
      divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2 / 2) 0 (-1) = 1 / 2 ∧
      (∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, -|u| ≤ divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2 / 2) u (-1) -
        divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2 / 2) u 0 - divergence (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2 / 2) 0 (-1)) ∧
      (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2
